verdict.rationale: Vue claims a performant, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely needs manual optimization and an ecosystem that scales up to a full framework. It also ships official Router and Pinia libraries for structuring larger apps, and one team reports being happier at scale with the official router/store. Hands-on reports are mixed on maintainability as complexity grows: users describe Vue as too 'magical' for really complex apps, cite confusing state/data flow in semi-large apps, and note no accepted best practices and second-class TypeScript prop typing. missing for 10: in-depth first-party guidance on large-app architecture and team scaling, performance evidence or benchmarks for large codebases, consistent independent corroboration of maintainability at scale, solid TypeScript support for large teams.
